package probe

import (
	"context"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

// These are the shapes the e2e tier runs: flags the exemption refuses none of,
// and positional arguments the source builds at run time.
func toolchainArguments(ctx context.Context, binaryPath string) error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-o", binaryPath, filepath.Join("..", "..", "cmd", "x"))
	if out, err := build.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		_ = out
		return err
	}

	list := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "go", "list", "-deps", "./cmd/x")
	_, err := list.Output()
	return err
}
